versions.subject: rule: RAR greedy compression
versions.detection:
# example : rar.exe a -m5 -r -y -ta20210204000000 -hp1qazxcde32ws -v2560k Asia1Dpt-PC-c.rar c:\\*.doc c:\\*.docx c:\\*.xls c:\\*.xlsx c:\\*.pdf c:\\*.ppt c:\\*.pptx c:\\*.jpg c:\\*.txt >nul
selection_opt1:
  - Image|endswith: '\rar.exe'
  - Description: 'Command line RAR'
selection_opt2:
  CommandLine|contains:
    - '.exe a '
    - ' a -m'
selection_cmdline:
  CommandLine|contains|all:
    - ' -hp' # password
    - ' -r ' # recursive
selection_folders:
  CommandLine|contains:
    - ' C:\\*.'
    - ' C:\Users\Public\'
    - ' %public%'
    - ' C:\Windows\'
    - ' C:\PerfLogs\'
    - ' C:\Temp'
    - ' C:\$Recycle.bin\'
condition: 1 of selection_opt* and selection_cmdline and selection_folders
versions.spl: Image="*\\rar.exe" OR Description="Command line RAR" OR CommandLine IN ("*.exe a *", "* a -m*") CommandLine="* -hp*" CommandLine="* -r *" CommandLine IN ("* C:\\*.*", "* C:\\Users\\Public\\*", "* %public%*", "* C:\\Windows\\*", "* C:\\PerfLogs\\*", "* C:\\Temp*", "* C:\\$Recycle.bin\\*")
